    Profile

    Birgitta is a wandering witch who, despite her childlike appearance, is actually pretty long in the tooth. She's an inherently friendly and generous person, and can never resist giving little treats to any children or animals that she comes across. The fact that she doesn't age physically is said to be somehow related to her ability to communicate with animals, but whether this is true or not is uncertain.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 140cm
    Weight: 30kg
    Birthday: Dec 19
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Butter tea
    Hobbies: Embroidery and weaving
    Illust: 渡り棒
    CV: 下地紫野
